Name: Spooky Scary Creatures
Author: petulinda
Description:
[size=3][b][center][color=#bf9000]H[/color][color=#f1c232]a[/color][color=#ffd966]l[/color][color=#ffe599]l[/color][color=#fff2cc]o[/color]ween is c[color=#fce5cd]o[/color][color=#f9cb9c]m[/color][color=#f6b26b]i[/color][color=#e69138]n[/color][color=#b45f06]g[/color][color=#ff7700]![/color][/center][/b][/size][center][i](N[/i][i]o matter what time of the year it is, it is always coming.)[/i][/center]
As I was finding spooky, scary and monster-y mods for Stardew Valley, none of them actually changed the wild animals we see in the game, so here I am, with my own spooky animal army!

[center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]Woodpecker? Yes, but he's got a new surname - [u][color=#ff7700]Bloodbutt[/color][/u].
Cute little rabbits? No more, they are poisonous [color=#ff7700][u]snakes[/u] [/color]now. Don't step on one.
Did you say frogs, Sebastian? You should check Wikipedia, these look more like [u][color=#ff7700]spiders[/color][/u].
Butterflies. What a word. Butter. Flies. No. [u][color=#ff7700]Flying eyeballs[/color][/u], that's better. (And also [u][color=#ff7700]bats[/color][/u]. Depends on the season.)
Birds, what cute little creatures they are. Especially as [u][color=#ff7700]ghosts[/color][/u].
Speaking of ghosts, check out the seagulls. They're [u][color=#ff7700]radioactive[/color][/u].
When feeling a little bit cold, go catch a [u][color=#ff7700]fire squirrel[/color][/u]. Yup, a legit species now.
Or a [u][color=#ff7700]phoenix[/color][/u], those are a little bit more frequent to spot.
In the evening, you might even see an [color=#ff7700][u]eagle[/u] [/color]fly by your farm.
Only [color=#ff7700][u]crows[/u] [/color]stayed the same. Their beaty remains.[/size][/font][/center][center][/center]
[b][u][color=#ff7700]Installation:[/color][/u][/b]
1. Backup your Content folder.
2. Put the critters.xnb file into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Content/TileSheets[/font] and overwrite.
3. Start the game and go look for the creatures!

[b]In case run into any problems with the mod, please let me know! I've tested it as much as I could, but if something looks wrong to you, I'll fix it. :)

[/b][center][color=#ff0000][size=3]Enjoy your spooky game!
